name: Vantablack Site Perimeter Tech Uniform
description: Worn by Vantablack's perimeter security and site surveillance personnel — the operational layer below full intelligence operatives — this uniform is deliberately understated. Flat charcoal trousers with reinforced knee panels pair with a close-cut long-sleeve duty shirt in the same tone. The fabric is a matte microfiber engineered to absorb ambient light at a higher rate than standard materials, reducing visual signature under low-light conditions without full stealth-tech coating. Chest pockets are sealed with magnetic closures, and the collar has an integrated signal-dampening layer that partially obscures BCI handshake emissions within a one-meter radius. No visible branding. A small Vantablack registry code is laser-etched inside the collar.
cultural_context: Vantablack uniforms are designed to be forgettable, and they largely succeed. Personnel in these uniforms occupy the background of corporate events, transit hubs, and high-tier building lobbies — present but unregistered in the mind. That invisibility is the point, and it makes them deeply unsettling to those who know what they're looking at.
story_hooks: A perimeter tech is found to have been wearing their uniform off-shift, conducting what appears to be unauthorized surveillance of a Tier 2 community organizer.
Someone is selling reproductions of the uniform at a gray market stall — the BCI dampening collar works, and it's attracting the wrong kind of buyers.
A player acquires one and discovers the registry code inside the collar is linked to a personnel file that officially doesn't exist.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately forgettable silhouette—austere and recessive. The wearer becomes a negative space in the room: a flat charcoal figure that the eye slides past. The uniform's effect is psychological; it reads as 'present but not there.' Slim, efficient lines from shoulder to ankle create the impression of someone built for observation rather than action.
physical_description.fit: Close-cut and compression-oriented without being restrictive. The shirt hugs the torso and shoulders; the trousers taper slightly at the ankle. Designed for unrestricted movement during long surveillance shifts, but tailored enough to maintain a professional boundary. Sits somewhere between athletic and formal—neither quite accessible.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte microfiber engineered with light-absorption properties. Feels dense and smooth to the touch but has an almost non-reflective quality under any lighting condition. The fibers are treated to reduce light bounce, making the uniform visually 'quieter' than standard fabrics.
physical_description.texture: Completely smooth and featureless at a distance; up close, a tight microfiber weave with almost imperceptible surface variation. No shine, no sheen, no texture that catches light. Deliberately austere.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat, desaturated charcoal throughout—no accent colors, no piping, no variation. A single tone chosen to blend into shadows and corporate interiors alike. The uniformity is absolute.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closures on both chest pockets (silent, secure, no audible click). The shirt itself closes with a friction-fit magnetic collar system that leaves no visible seams. Trousers feature a standard magnetic waistband closure, unmarked.
distinctive_features: Integrated signal-dampening layer in the collar—invisible to the eye but disrupts BCI handshake emissions within a one-meter radius
Reinforced knee panels (subtly darker, barely visible) for durability during extended surveillance work
Laser-etched Vantablack registry code inside the collar—the only identifying mark, meant to be found only on inspection
Sealed magnetic chest pockets with no visible hardware
Absence of any corporate branding, logos, or visual markers—complete anonymity by design
Microfiber engineered to absorb ambient light at a higher rate than standard materials
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional—not luxury, but precision-engineered and expensive in ways only other operatives would recognize. The cost is in the materials and the silence, not in visible status markers.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by the invisible layer of Vantablack's security apparatus—perimeter and surveillance personnel who are meant to be forgotten the moment they're no longer in direct line of sight. Signals corporate surveillance infrastructure, unglamorous but essential fieldwork, and participation in the hidden scaffolding of corpo power. The wearer is present but psychologically absent—a tool rather than a person in the eyes of those around them.
physical_description.condition_typical: Impeccably maintained and worn. No patching, no weathering, but constant use. The fabric shows the faintest scuff marks at the knees and elbows—evidence of surveillance work in industrial and corporate settings. Each uniform is rotated and cleaned to maintain optimal light-absorption properties.

image_prompt: Midjourney fashion photography: A lithe androgynous figure in a flat charcoal microfiber uniform—close-cut long-sleeve shirt and reinforced trousers—standing in shadow against a brutalist corporate lobby or dimly-lit transit hub. The fabric absorbs light unnaturally, creating an almost void-like silhouette. Moody tungsten and neon backlighting emphasizes the uniform's ability to recede visually. Subtle magnetic closures catch the faintest reflection. The model's expression is neutral, professional, forgettable. Dark urban neo-noir urban aesthetic, clean lines, cold color temperature, atmospheric perspective. Fashion photography with an unsettling sense of erasure. --ar 2:3 --v 6
